headline: The peso loses 1.97% against the dollar
summary: The peso hit its weakest level since the 2025 tariff announcement, driven by bets on a narrower interest rate differential and unwinding of carry trade positions.
why: The peso is a widely traded emerging-market currency, and its moves reflect global carry trade flows and the gap between Mexican and US interest rates.
why_moved: Expectations of a smaller interest rate gap between Mexico and the US, together with liquidation of carry trade positions, pushed the peso lower.
original_headline: El peso pierde 1.97% frente al dólar
